fields.help: removeDuplicateInputItems: drop repeats within this run. removeItemsRepeatedWithinPreviousExecutions: keep only items that are new compared with earlier runs of this workflow (see Keep Items Where; e.g. new feed entries on a schedule). clearDeduplicationHistory: forget the stored values and maximums and pass items through.
fields.label: Operation

fields.help: Items with the same value in this field are deduplicated. Leave empty to deduplicate by the entire item.
fields.label: Deduplicate By Field

fields.help: Which occurrence to keep when duplicates are found.
fields.label: Keep

fields.help: removeItemsWithAlreadySeenKeyValues: the value is new (not in the history). removeItemsUpToStoredIncrementalKey: the value is a number higher than any earlier run's. removeItemsUpToStoredDate: the value is a date later than any earlier run's. The last two store only the maximum.
fields.label: Keep Items Where

fields.help: Value compared with earlier runs: an expression evaluated per item or a dot-path field. Empty falls back to the field above,then to the whole item. Items with an empty value fail the node.
fields.label: Dedupe Value

fields.help: node: this node keeps its own history. workflow: every remove-duplicates node of the workflow shares one history.
fields.label: History Scope

fields.help: Most values remembered (removeItemsWithAlreadySeenKeyValues only); the least recently seen are forgotten first (and could pass again).
fields.label: History Size

outputs.description: the input item's fields, passed through
